svg.title: RU-EN-LID Stage 2: candidate-conditioned XLM-R
svg.desc: Stage 1's tag and Urdu reading are added to each word piece's input embedding; with the new parameters at zero the model equals plain XLM-R. Twelve transformer layers read the sentence and a token head outputs UR, EN or OTH with a temperature-scaled confidence.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stage 1's evidence is added to each word's input embedding, so all 12 layers can weigh the lexicon against the sentence.
